general_information.name: UM—SORRY, DO YOU MEAN MY FULL NAME ON MY ID? I’M NOT SURE IF YOU WANT THE WHOLE THING ALL AT ONCE. IT’S NAOMI… FLETCHER, I THINK, BUT I MIGHT BE MIXING UP THE EXACT FORMAT.
general_information.family_doctor_name: I THINK SO, YES — IT’S DR. CHU, MAYBE HELEN CHU? I’M NOT TOTALLY SURE IF YOU WANTED THE SURNAME FIRST OR THE WHOLE NAME TOGETHER, SORRY.

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s mostly… the eating stuff. I’ve been restricting for years, counting calories all the time, and I still get stuck on my body shape. I can’t really eat with other people without planning it for days first, which is exhausting.
current_concerns.goals: I want to be able to eat a meal with friends without having to plan it for days beforehand. And, um, maybe stop feeling like my whole day is organized around food.

The CBT for eating disorders was in 2023.; Oh, for each of them? I think it was about 20 sessions for the family-based treatment, and also about 20 sessions for the CBT for eating disorders.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born and raised in Toronto, and I was a pretty perfectionistic child, I guess. That’s the main thing I remember.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: High achieving, mostly. The eating difficulties started in the final year of school, and then things kind of kept going from there… I don’t know if you want more detail than that.
personal_history.significant_relationships: I’m single. I don’t really have a relationship to describe there.
personal_history.future_goals: I’d like to finish a master’s degree, and stop planning my day around food.
